newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-MYERS THE LAST-GASP HERO FOR BOLOGNA.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-MYERS THE LAST-GASP HERO FOR BOLOGNA.

text.p: Carlton Myers kept Team System Bologna in the hunt for a place in European basketball's Final Four on Thursday, stopping an equaliser and then firing a two-pointer in the final seconds against Barcelona, last year's finalists.

With the home team leading the more favoured Spaniards 68-65, the American prevented ex-Bologna playmaker Alexander Djordjevic from netting a three-pointer and then raced up the court on the rebound for the 70-65 win.
Barcelona led for the opening part of the first half and were five points ahead after five minutes.
But Team System cut the gap, leading 37-33 at the break with Myers providing 11 points and Eric Murdock the same.
"We did what we had to do," said Team System coach Valerio Bianchini. "Now the match stays open, that's all. If they had won this one, it would have been all over."
Barcelona coach Aito Garcia Reneses said Bologna were stronger than expected but he remained confident.
"I'm unhappy with the performance, but we can still win," he said. "Unfortunately Djordjevic was not on top form."
Murdock proved the top scorer of the night with 21 points, ahead of fellow-American Myers on 18.
The return leg is on Barcelona on Tuesday with a playoff in Bologna if needed two days later.
